t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It is important to pay attention to the colorful gnome - pink, brown, blue. Sometimes green gives more success while sometimes it may not.

vb_textbox.text: After picking and gathering, the colors to avoid is green and yellow. sometimes they might be a successful pick but other times they are not. The colors to pick are brown, red, pink and purple. Having said, blue could be sneaky.
